name: Lot Split: the full list
description: Every Minneapolis 1-3 unit lot big enough to split in two under the Chapter 540 built-form rules: address, lot size, street side, district, owner type, assessor value and last sale, with new county sales merged in each time you open it.
line: The full list of every lot that passes, with owner, assessor value and last sale, as a spreadsheet, with new county sales added each time you open it, is $150, once.
